preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.
First element of the arithmetic progression A1 is between 1 and 10^9.
Common difference D between successive members of A is between 0 and 10^9.
Upper bound R of the range is between 1 and 10^18.
Lower bound L of the range is between 1 and R.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(F(Ai) for i in range(L, R+1))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of F(Ai) for L ≤ i ≤ R.
